qualifier: glucuronate route to xylulose 5-phosphate
name: Glucuronate-xylulose pathway to xylulose 5-phosphate
rationale: All members concern the uronate route from glucuronate through xylulose to xylulose 5-phosphate (including essential pentosuria), unlike confusables centred on the non-oxidative pentose phosphate shunt, fructose, galactose or alditols.

qualifier: cardiac relaxation and lowering cytosolic calcium
name: Cardiac sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium cycling and relaxation
rationale: Members regulate SR calcium release/reuptake (ryanodine receptor, SERCA, Na/Ca exchange) with emphasis on relaxation, reduced heart rate and cytosolic calcium lowering, whereas confusables add positive force of contraction, caffeine response or generic transporters.

qualifier: proinsulin processing and incretin (GLP-1, GIP) stimulation
name: Beta-cell insulin processing and incretin-stimulated secretion
rationale: Members cover insulin processing, beta-cell identity and glucose/GLP-1/GIP-stimulated insulin release, distinguishing it from confusables on K-ATP channels, fatty-acid or neural modulation, GLUT4 translocation or pancreatic development.

qualifier: biotin-dependent carboxylases and organic acidurias
name: Branched-chain acyl-CoA catabolism and biotin-dependent carboxylases
rationale: Members are leucine/valine/isoleucine catabolic steps after BCKDH, their inborn organic acidurias and biotin recycling for carboxylases, unlike confusables on BCKDH/MSUD, lipoylation or fatty acid oxidation.

qualifier: trophoblast giant cells, endoreduplication and decidualization
name: Peri-implantation lineages and trophoblast giant cell endoreduplication
rationale: Members specify early embryonic lineages (trophectoderm, inner cell mass, primordial germ cells) and implantation-site cells (endoreduplicating giant trophoblast, decidua), unlike confusables on labyrinth/chorionic placenta or germ-cell maintenance.

qualifier: retinoic acid signaling
name: G0 quiescence transitions in retinoic acid-driven differentiation
rationale: Members regulate entry into and exit from G0 during differentiation together with retinoic acid receptor signaling and RA-induced TFAP2A repression, unlike p53/FOXO arrest or thyroid/nuclear receptor confusables.

qualifier: RNA polymerase I termination plus 5S rRNA by RNA polymerase III
name: RNA polymerase I termination and 5S rRNA transcription
rationale: Members are Pol I transcription termination and Pol III 5S rRNA transcription, whereas confusables cover Pol I initiation, rDNA chromatin regulation or other Pol III/snRNA transcription.

qualifier: mesangium, endothelium and basement membrane
name: Glomerular mesangium, endothelium and filtration barrier development
rationale: Members concern glomerular mesangial, endothelial, epithelial and basement membrane development plus filtration and albumin handling, unlike confusables on tubule segments, kidney growth control or podocyte nephrin/migration.

qualifier: initiation: preinitiation complex, promoter opening and escape
name: RNA polymerase I transcription initiation and promoter escape
rationale: All members are early Pol I steps (preinitiation complex assembly, promoter opening, escape), distinguishing it from Pol I termination/elongation, rRNA processing and Pol III confusables.

qualifier: alkylation reversal, TET/TDG demethylation and BER gap filling
name: Alkylation damage reversal, active DNA demethylation and BER gap-filling
rationale: Members cover direct reversal of alkylation (ALKBH2/3, MGMT), TET/TDG-driven 5-methylcytosine demethylation and post-incision short/long-patch BER, whereas confusables centre on glycosylase recognition/cleavage, NEIL/OGG1 defects or methionine salvage.

qualifier: UV and oxidative stress with SASP
name: UV and oxidative stress-induced senescence and SASP
rationale: Members describe growth arrest, premature senescence and SASP triggered by UV and oxidative stress, unlike confusables on oncogene-induced senescence, Polycomb silencing or p53 apoptosis regulation.

qualifier: collagen degradation and metalloproteinase activation
name: Extracellular matrix and metalloproteinase-mediated collagen degradation
rationale: Members are ECM gene modules, EMT and collagen catabolism via MMP activation, distinguishing them from confusables on collagen synthesis/elastic fibres or integrin and stromal adhesion signaling.

qualifier: condensation, cohesion establishment and CENP-A deposition
name: Chromosome condensation, cohesion establishment and centromeric CENP-A deposition
rationale: Members build mitotic/meiotic chromosome architecture through condensation, cohesin loading and centromeric CENP-A assembly, unlike confusables on cohesion resolution, replication-coupled chromatin assembly or nuclear envelope dynamics.

qualifier: transcription initiation/termination and mtDNA repair
name: Mitochondrial transcription and mtDNA maintenance
rationale: Most members concern mitochondrial transcription and mtDNA repair/metabolism, distinguishing the theme from confusables on mitochondrial RNA decay, translation and mtDNA replication.

qualifier: cytokine production, proliferation and Treg differentiation
name: T cell suppression: cytokines, proliferation and Treg differentiation
rationale: Members restrain T cell activation, proliferation and cytokine output (IL-2, IFN-gamma, IL-10, IL-21) and regulate Treg differentiation, unlike confusables on T cell signaling/Th1, tolerance induction, innate inflammatory cytokines or NK cells.

qualifier: phorbol ester and lipid-mediator activation
name: Protein kinase C signaling and phorbol ester response
rationale: Members converge on PKC activation by phorbol ester, phosphoinositide/lipid receptors, VEGFR2 and estrogen via PRKCZ, whereas confusables emphasize G protein calcium, cAMP, BCR or Wnt-calcium signaling.

qualifier: FSH-responsive Sertoli cells
name: Gonadotropin secretion and FSH-responsive Sertoli cell development
rationale: Members link FSH/LH secretion with FSH response, Sertoli cell proliferation and seminiferous tubule development, unlike confusables on ovarian follicles, Leydig/germ cells or activin signaling.

qualifier: attachment, entry and cell fusion
name: Viral attachment, entry and host-cell fusion
rationale: Members center on virion attachment, receptor-mediated entry and fusion across dengue, RSV, influenza, HIV and SARS-CoV, distinguishing the theme from confusables on viral protein maturation or host restriction of infection.

qualifier: methylation
name: tRNA and rRNA methylation
rationale: Members are tRNA, rRNA and guanine-N7 methylation events, separating the theme from confusables on rRNA processing, pseudouridylation, tRNA aminoacylation or wobble modification.

qualifier: phosphatidylcholine, phosphatidylethanolamine and phosphatidylinositol
name: Acyl-chain remodeling of PC, PE and PI
rationale: Members are Lands-cycle acyl-chain remodeling of PC, PE and PI, unlike confusables on PG/PS remodeling, PA/DAG/TAG synthesis or phospholipid catabolism.

qualifier: generic receptor tyrosine kinase and oncogenic PI3K
name: Receptor tyrosine kinase-driven PI3K/AKT and ERK activation
rationale: Members describe RTK autophosphorylation driving PI3K/AKT (including aberrant cancer PI3K) and ERK, without the insulin/IGF1R, ALK/LTK or MET receptor specificity of the confusables.

qualifier: dentin, enamel and cementum mineralization
name: Tooth development and dental tissue mineralization
rationale: Members cover odontogenesis, odontoblast differentiation, dentin/enamel/cementum mineralization and eruption, unlike confusables on bone mineralization, phosphate/FGF23 signaling or ectodermal appendages.

core: Cell-matrix adhesion control in epithelial migration
qualifier: suppression of adhesion, Rac/Rho signaling and lamellipodia
name: Suppression of cell-matrix adhesion and lamellipodia in epithelial migration
rationale: Members inhibit integrin signaling, cell-matrix adhesion, spreading and Rac/Rho-driven lamellipodia while regulating epithelial/keratinocyte migration, unlike CDC42/actin polymerization or VEGFR confusables.

qualifier: cholesterol, ubiquinone and vitamin K-dependent carboxylation
name: Mevalonate isoprenoids: cholesterol, ubiquinone and vitamin K carboxylation
rationale: Members span mevalonate/isoprenoid synthesis feeding cholesterol, ubiquinol and menaquinone, plus vitamin K metabolism and gamma-carboxylation, unlike confusables on vitamin E, cholesterol catabolism/bile acids or cytochrome P450 defects.

qualifier: NFE2L2 regulation and target gene classes
name: NFE2L2-driven transcription and its regulation
rationale: Every member concerns NFE2L2 (NRF2) target genes or its expression/degradation, distinguishing it from p53, ER-stress/FOXO and ROS-detoxification confusables.
